days.rollupZh: 今日焦点仍集中在 AI 智能体：YC 实验室让智能体集群在游戏中运行，业界呼吁实时监控智能体行为，GitHub 数据显示 2026 年开发者已用智能体推动提交量创新高。OpenAI 发布更新版 Model Spec 并介绍前沿模型对齐失准的检测方法，同时扩大与 ServiceNow 的企业合作。技术侧还有把 DOOM 改成 Transformer、以及在树莓派 Pico 2 W 上跑小型世界模型等趣味实验。
days.rollupEn: AI agents dominate today's news: YC Labs ran agent swarms in games, MIT Technology Review urges real-time monitoring of agent actions, and GitHub's Octoverse shows 2026 commits hitting new highs as developers build with agents. OpenAI published an updated Model Spec, explained how it detects frontier model misalignment, and expanded its ServiceNow partnership. On the playful side, developers turned DOOM into a Transformer and ran a tiny world model on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W.
